# gadget

A whole number, held by the embedder; render it with [`string`](https://github.com/jokruger/kavun/blob/main/docs/reference/types/string.md) text.

Its members are the embedder's own names beside the builtin ones: see [`double`](#double).

## Members

- [`double() -> int`](#double)
- [`len() -> int`](#len)

<a id="double"></a>
### `double() -> int`

Answer twice the gadget's number.

```go
g.double()
```

<a id="len"></a>
### `len() -> int`

Answer the gadget's number.
